children: Australian shares were set to open slightly lower on Monday, with declines in gold miners likely to offset strength in energy stocks, while weaker-than-expected jobs data last week scaled back bets on further central bank tightening.
The local share price index futures (YAPcm1) fell 0.1% and were at a 19.3-point premium to the underlying S&P/ASX 200 index's
last close. The benchmark rose 1% on Friday.
